statement: The inspected Linux v7.3 hid-playstation DualSense output worker handles shared rumble, lightbar, player LEDs, microphone mute, and related audio-routing fields. It enables the compatible vibration v2 path for Edge but contains no Edge-specific profile-management report path in the inspected file. Absence of that path is not proof that the device lacks such reports.

applicability.scope: Linux v7.3 source-handled output and feature scope, not controller capability
